name: casino-business-overview
description: Vegas Casino business + RED overview (Step-2 metrics + Catalog B1 spanmetrics).

header.content:
# 🎰 Vegas Casino — Business Overview

Built from the Step-2 business metrics (`casino.bets.count`, `casino.wager.amount`) and the Catalog B1 span-derived RED metrics (`casino.red.*`). Deployed with `dtctl` — see the lab README.

bets_rate.title: Bets per minute by outcome
bets_rate.query: timeseries bets = sum(casino.bets.count), by: { casino.outcome }, from: now() - 1h

wager_p90.title: Wager p90 by game
wager_p90.query: timeseries wager_p90 = percentile(casino.wager.amount, 90), by: { casino.game.name }, from: now() - 1h

red_rate.title: RED — call rate by operation
red_rate.query: timeseries calls = sum(casino.red.calls), by: { span.name, status.code }, from: now() - 1h

red_duration.title: RED — p90 duration by operation
red_duration.query: timeseries d_p90 = percentile(casino.red.duration, 90), by: { span.name }, from: now() - 1h

total_wagered.title: Total wagered (1h)
total_wagered.query: timeseries w = sum(casino.wager.amount), from: now() - 1h | summarize total = sum(arraySum(w))
